_note: Settings of the template library (j2_template_lib.py reads this file; nothing here is repeated in code). no_business_type: what a charter's business_type holds when it recorded none (two such values are never the same business). stop_words and min_word_length: the words words() leaves out when two texts are compared. fact_fields: the shapes of a charter fact that name fields; the first pattern that matches a fact is used, {noun} is group 1 as an identifier, {Noun} the same in title case, {word} group 1 as written, {fact} the whole fact, {item} one listed name. routing: the numbers the router holds the template generator to; the generator is told each one in its prompt (routing.rules), and a reply that breaks one is refused with the rule, never changed by code.

fact_fields.name: {noun}
fact_fields.description: {fact}; one item each, copied from the charter ([] when the charter doesn't list them)
fact_fields.item_description: the {item}, as the charter gives it

fact_fields.name: {noun}_form_fields
fact_fields.description: the fields of the {word} form this section names, from the charter: {fact}

rules: Code reuses a template without asking you when the same need made it, or when it covers {reuse_without_asking_coverage} of the need; you are asked only when neither holds.
reuse: the template must be one of the candidates and cover at least {reuse_min} of the need.
extend: the template must be one of the candidates and cover at least {extend_min} of the need; below that, create a new template instead.
create: the name must not be the name of a candidate; code never renames a template.
A reply that breaks a rule is refused and you are asked once more with the reason; after {generator_attempts} refused replies the builder fills the generic template.
